fact_text: On 15 Sep 2025 the State Bank of Pakistan's monetary policy committee kept the policy rate unchanged at 11%, a hold the guest said was not a major surprise.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Core inflation (non-food, non-energy) had fallen to about 7% by 15 Sep 2025, down from about 10% a few months before, though the pace of decline had slowed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: SBP data released about two weeks before this video showed food inflation at about 5.06% year on year, a high in over 35 weeks; food prices then fell again in that data.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Floods usually hit food inflation first because crop damage pushes up food prices quickly, and food then feeds into headline inflation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The SBP named flood risk as the main risk to the outlook, saying floods could weigh on GDP growth and the external account.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Official flood damage assessments had not been published as of 15 Sep 2025, so the economic cost was not yet quantified by the authorities.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The 2022 floods had an estimated economic impact of 10 to 14 billion USD, according to the guest.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Analysts and research houses estimated the 2025 flood impact at about 1 to 2 billion USD, far smaller than 2022, so the economy was seen as better placed to absorb it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Floods hit Kharif crops such as rice and cotton, but better water availability later could lift Kharif yields and the Rabi wheat crop.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The guest said the flood impact had not reached Sindh much, and receding floodwater in some areas was a positive sign.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The SBP said the near-term outlook had worsened on inflation and the current account but called this deterioration temporary.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The SBP said its foreign exchange reserves had stayed stable despite foreign debt payments.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The SBP said inflation expectations among households and businesses had risen somewhat, which it expected to be temporary.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The SBP said uncertainty from US tariffs had eased, one of the four factors it flagged as having changed since the prior decision.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: FBR tax collection in the first two months of FY26 was about 14% higher year on year but fell short of the target.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The guest expected the SBP profit transferred to the government in Q1 FY26 to help meet the primary surplus target despite lower interest rates.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Economic momentum in cement sales, auto sales and private credit had begun to rise and was seen in the first two months of FY26, though it was expected to ease in the near term.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Circular debt in the power sector stood at about 2.3 trillion rupees.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The guest said reforms such as privatisation, including Pakistan International Airlines, and power distribution company restructuring with private sector participation were moving slowly.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Shopping observations by the guest showed tomatoes falling from Rs 200 to Rs 160 per kg against the previous Saturday at the same market, with onions also cheaper.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: An IMF team was due to visit Pakistan the week after 15 Sep 2025 to assess whether flood losses could be absorbed within the existing fiscal space.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: A first climate finance disbursement of about 200 million USD was expected alongside the IMF review, which could help fund transport, livestock and agriculture recovery.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The SBP's next monetary policy committee meeting is scheduled for 27 Oct 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The guest said a cut of even 1 percentage point would be meaningful, and that the SBP would be cautious, so a hold at the October 2025 meeting was more likely.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The guest said the government must make prudent fiscal decisions, and that flood costs were not yet too large to manage given the fiscal space.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The guest said FX reserves, the current account and remittances were on the positive side of the outlook.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Analyzing the State Bank's Monetary Policy Decision | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)
